text: We recognise the critical role that caregivers play in caring for their loved ones with special needs and the importance of supporting families with persons with disabilities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Support for caregivers is indeed crucial to the children's well-being and development.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Early intervention centres provide caregiver engagement and training so that caregivers are equipped with the skills and knowledge to support their children at home.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: We continue to improve access to knowledge and skills for parents with special needs children to carry out their caregiving duties and connect them with support networks.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: For example, ECDA launched a Parents' Guide last year to provide parents with information on ways to access EI services, support available to facilitate the child's transition from the preschool years to school-age provisions, as well as self-care strategies and resources.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: SG Enable has also worked with CaringSG, a caregiver-led organisation, to launch the Step One programme in July 2023.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Mr Louis Ng asked for the equalisation of benefits to single unwed parents, starting with the extension of the cash component of the Baby Bonus scheme.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Many of the existing benefits are already equalised.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: These include subsidies for education, healthcare, infant care and childcare, the foreign domestic worker levy concession as well as CDA benefits.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Rather than see the Baby Bonus cash gift as discriminatory to single unwed parents, it should be seen as a separate benefit to specifically promote parenthood within marriage.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Hence, it is extended only to married parents.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: I fully empathise with the challenges faced by single unwed parents, in particular, those who are lower-income.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Currently, single unwed parents requiring support with their basic living expenses can approach our Social Service Offices (SSOs).

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Our SSOs will assess their households' needs and circumstances and provide ComCare financial assistance if they meet the criteria.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Our SSOs may also refer them to other Government agencies and community partners for further support.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Family Service Centres also work with single unwed parents and their children to address their social and emotional needs, not forgetting that there are bottom-up initiatives such as the Northeast Community Development Council's "North East Growth Fund", which provide subsidies for formula milk and diapers to young children up to six years old so as to support new mothers.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Claim information that cannot be validated against Government data will be verified by our processing officers against supporting documents.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: In addition, disbursed claims will be selectively reviewed to detect erroneous payments to employers, employees and self-employed persons.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: If any erroneous payment is identified and verified to have taken place, the CDCA grants the Government powers to recover such monies from employers, employees and self-employed persons, as the case may be.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: We will undertake the recovery of such monies in a timely manner.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Assoc Prof Razwana Begum asked several questions regarding Approved Persons.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: The primary role of the Approved Person is to oversee the withdrawal of CDA funds in respect of an Approved Institution.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Approved Persons must be able to fulfil their roles and responsibilities specified in the Child Development Co-Savings Regulations as well as MSF's Terms and Conditions for Approved Persons and Approved Institutions.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: For those who have not been proper in carrying out their role as an Approved Person, MSF will suspend their approval.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: The suspension safeguards the child's CDA funds but does not mean that the relevant Approved Institution has to cease service provision for the child.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: For instance, a preschool can continue its delivery of services as long as it remains licensed by ECDA.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: The amendments to section 7 provide for a simplified process wherein revocation of the approval granted to these Approved Persons does not need to be approved by the Minister.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: This would be applied in specific situations that can be determined objectively, such as where the Approved Institution is no longer able to provide services because it has ceased operations.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: I hope these clarification address Assoc Prof Razwana Begum's questions.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: The amendments being made to the Child Development Co-Savings Act via this Bill is a clear signal of the Government's continued commitment to increase our support for parents in managing their work and family commitments.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: We will continue to do our best to provide such assurance to Singaporeans who are planning to embark on their parenthood journey.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: At the same time, we are fully aware that schemes and subsidies alone are insufficient.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: At the broader level, we must strive to nurture a society that embraces family and is family-friendly.

speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling)
text: Every one of us has a part to play in building a Singapore Made for Families, where families are valued and supported.
